summary: The candidate resolves both follow-up findings: the duplicate test import is removed, duplicate cookie rejection is limited to the __Host session cookie while other cookies keep first-value parsing, and a regression test covers duplicate login CSRF cookies.

evidence: src/session_cookie.ts now rejects duplicates only when the cookie name equals HUB_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME and otherwise retains the first value with found ??= value.slice(...).
tests/passport_cutover_test.ts removes the duplicate HUB_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME import and imports LOGIN_CSRF_COOKIE_NAME once in the same import block.

The new duplicate login CSRF regression test covers both cookie orderings, successful login with the first nonce, invalid_login_csrf for the second nonce, and invalid_origin for a cross-origin request.
